mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.intro, p.cover, p.style, p.creator_id, p.is_public, p.create_time
, COALESCE(u.name, '官方') AS creator_name, COALESCE(u.avatar, '') AS creator_avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist_song ps WHERE ps.playlist_id = p.id) AS song_count
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM playlist p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.creator_id
AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.intro LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.style LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND p.style = #{style}
ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC
SELECT FROM playlist p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.creator_id WHERE p.creator_id = #{creatorId} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.id DESC
SELECT FROM playlist p JOIN user_favorite f ON f.playlist_id = p.id AND f.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.creator_id ORDER BY f.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM playlist p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.creator_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO playlist (name, intro, cover, style, creator_id, is_public, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{intro}, #{cover}, #{style}, #{creatorId}, #{isPublic}, NOW())
INSERT IGNORE INTO user_favorite (user_id, playlist_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{playlistId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND playlist_id = #{playlistId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM user_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND playlist_id = #{playlistId}
